card.name: Linking words in medieval Serbian king story
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, to, at, King) inside a historical narrative about Serbian kings, especially Stephen Uros III and his father Milutin, just before a person or place name.

modes.label: Linking words before royal names
modes.description: Words like of, King or son that lead into the name of a king or ruler in a biography.
modes.example: He was born the eldest son<< of>> the saintly King Milutin (

modes.label: Linking words before places
modes.description: Words like to, at or of that lead into a Balkan town or country name.
modes.example: he had his father's remains transferred from Zvecan<< to>> Decani, where they were placed in

card.writes: No clear output effect; it promotes odd name fragments and suppresses Chinese words for leadership and management.
